note: Site Alpha niche file for this copy of the booking-request engine. A sister site replaces this file and keeps the form code. Performer id "other" opens a free-text field. The checklist is a worksheet people print and keep. It is not submitted and it is not a contract.
senderAddress: PO Box 1604, Okotoks, AB T1S 1B5, Canada
pageDescription: Ask The Celtic Coo to introduce you to a piper, drummer, ceilidh band, Highland dancer or heavy athlete. We connect people with independent performers. We are not an agency.
heading: Book Celtic performers
lede: Need a piper for a wedding, a drummer for a dance competition, or a ceilidh band for the games? Tell Ceilidh what you need. She will pass the note to {email}, and we will write back.
disclosure: The Celtic Coo connects people with independent performers. We are not the performer, and we are not a booking agency. We share contact details privately, and only once both sides agree. We never publish the name of anyone under 18.
eventCta: Ceilidh can pass a request to independent pipers, drummers, dancers and bands for this event. We make the introduction. We are not the agency.
eventsHint: Pick one or more events already on The Celtic Coo, add your own, or both. Dates were confirmed on the organizer's site, except the ones marked Date TBA.
customHint: Not on the list? Pick a type, then name the event. Fill this in as well as, or instead of, the list above.
performersHint: Pick every kind of performer you need.
messageHint: Please don't include a minor's full name. We never publish one.
budgetHint: A rough range helps. It is not a quote, and nothing is booked until you and the performer agree.
under18Label: Is the performer or competitor under 18?
under18Note: Requests for anyone under 18 have to come from a parent or guardian. We never publish a minor's name, and this form does not ask for one.
guardianLabel: I confirm that I am the parent or guardian making this request.
caslLabel: I agree that The Celtic Coo may email me about this request. I can ask you to stop at any time.
storageHint: Required fields are marked with an asterisk. We send the request to {email}. If the site cannot deliver the form, you can email that address yourself. We do not store the form on the website.
requesterTypes: Parent or guardian (for an under-18 performer or competitor)
requestTypes: Find an accompanist for a competition (for example a solo drummer or Highland dancer who needs a piper or drummer)

checklist.title: Booking details checklist
checklist.description: A short checklist both sides can print and fill in: date, set times, fee, deposit, cancellation, travel, sound or equipment, and dress. It is not a contract.
checklist.intro: Once you and the performer are happy to talk, print this page and fill it in together. Each of you keeps a copy. The website does not save it, and it does not book anything.
checklist.disclaimer: This is a checklist, not a contract or legal advice. The Celtic Coo isn't a party to any agreement. Please use your own agreement.
checklist.nameLabel: Your name, for your own copy
checklist.otherNameLabel: The other person's name, for your own copy

items.label: Date
items.hint: The day of the performance or competition.

items.label: Set times
items.hint: When to arrive, when the set or competition starts, and when it finishes.

items.label: Fee
items.hint: The amount you both have in mind, and when it is paid.

items.label: Deposit
items.hint: Whether there is a deposit, how much, and when it is due.

items.label: Cancellation
items.hint: What you both want to do if the date changes or someone has to cancel.

items.label: Travel
items.hint: Who covers travel, and from where.

items.label: Sound or equipment
items.hint: What the venue provides, and what the performer brings.

items.label: Dress
items.hint: What to wear, if the event calls for it.
